constraints: lossless preservation and typed refusal precede speed
private reuse cannot change public API, lazy semantic timing, source identity, or error order
all resource/cancellation/size limits remain bounded and fail closed
allocation and latency evidence must be representative, paired, and hash-bound
iWork-only amendments/records are outside this DOCX measurement scope
0935 rejection is historical evidence only; it does not authorize reuse of its rejected parse-reuse patch or relaxed gates.

allocator_lane.metric_scope: Whole-process allocator gauges and max RSS; construction deltas are after_snapshot_drop absolute allocated_bytes/allocation_calls minus baseline, not absolute process totals.
allocator_lane.pair_unit: same sections, ownership, and repetition; version order alternates by repetition
allocator_lane.raw_held_across_footnote_focus: Retain after_snapshot_drop, commits_retained, releaseN-1, release_last, and drop gauges so raw-source retention across footnote/section work is visible; do not infer a phase attribution from these checkpoints.
required_metrics: max RSS from terminal time record

claim_scope: Prospective 48-child paired normal lane plus 24-child allocator lane; no timing, allocation, RSS, or adoption claim until all terminal records, semantic validation, and moved-packet replay pass.

required_report_contracts: monotone allocator gauges and live-byte conservation
region peak is present at creation/release endpoints and absent at commits_retained
returned_to_baseline=true and final live bytes equal baseline
shared/independent source sharing and measured validation counts match frozen fixtures

evidence_policy: No benchmark binary or artifact >=1 MiB is written under docs/performance/results. Repository receives only compact plans/receipts; raw packet, source listing, profiles, logs, and binaries stay under /home/zhuhe/litchi-performance-0937.

failure_and_replay.failed_child: preserve terminal, streams, report, and validation; invalidate interpretation rather than replacing the child
failure_and_replay.large_artifacts: all raw reports, logs, source listing, profiles, and archives remain external with size/SHA/regeneration descriptors
failure_and_replay.moved_replay: rehash copied source/build/runner/manifest/report/terminal/stream descriptors and recompute summaries from relative packet paths
failure_and_replay.observation_timeout: poll the same process; only confirmed deadline may terminate it

hypothesis: The reviewed combined candidate exposes one raw section topology to inventory semantic decoding and borrows footnote scanner events/resolver state, reducing duplicate fragment parsing and transient event/resolver copies while preserving validation order, lazy errors, namespace context, source spans, limits, tolerance mapping, exact output, and refusal behavior.

normal_lane.normal_guardrails: For every route and every paired block, candidate_p50 / baseline_p50 <=1.05; p95/p99/spread and max RSS increases >5% are review flags.
normal_lane.optional_latency_gate: Primary latency gate: generic_read_at baseline_p50 / candidate_p50 >=1.05 with nearest-rank bootstrap lower 95% >1.0; seed 937, 10000 paired draws. The 1.05 p50 safety guardrail is checked for every route in every paired block; p95/p99/spread, RSS and named peak increases >5% require review.
normal_lane.pair_unit: same route, block, and position; version order alternates by block
